class.name: SkyLook
class.brief_description: The sky's look as editable data: the haze's density and colour, other absorption, and colours by the sun's height.
class.description: A [TimeOfDay3D] applies its [member TimeOfDay3D.look] every frame: the haze and air properties go to the [AtmosphereEffect] (a change rebuilds its small tables), [member sky_tint] multiplies the sky's and the aerial perspective's light and [member sun_tint] the sunlight, both read at the sun's elevation between [member elevation_min] (offset 0) and [member elevation_max] (offset 1). Without gradients the sky is the physical one.

method.name: apply
method.description: Sets [param atmosphere]'s art properties and its sky tint for a sun at [param sun_elevation] degrees.

method.name: get_sky_tint_at
method.description: The sky's tint for a sun at [param sun_elevation] degrees (white without [member sky_tint]).

method.name: get_sky_recolor_at
method.description: The sky's recolour for a sun at [param sun_elevation] degrees (0 without [member sky_recolor]).

method.name: get_sun_tint_at
method.description: The sunlight's tint for a sun at [param sun_elevation] degrees (white without [member sun_tint]).

members.member: The colours other matter (smoke, dust) absorbs, per km at [member absorption_density]: blue absorbed leaves the sun and the sky orange.
How much of [member absorption_color] the air holds, per km at the ground, thinning with height as the haze.
How far the air seems: a multiplier on distance for the haze over the ground.
The sun's elevation in degrees at the gradients' offset 1.
The sun's elevation in degrees at the gradients' offset 0.
How much the haze scatters forward: higher, a tighter glow around the sun.
The haze, as a multiple of Earth's standard.
The colour the haze scatters; what it takes away is absorbed. Below white is physical.
The share of multiple scattering: the sky's fill.
The air's blue, as a multiple of Earth's.
A multiplier on the sky's and the aerial perspective's light.
How much the sky's own colour gives way to [member sky_tint] (its luminance in the tint's colour), 0 to 1, over the same sun elevations: a tint then makes a blue sky orange rather than brown.
How far up from the horizon [member sky_tint] and [member sky_recolor] reach, in radians of the view's elevation (they fade as exp(-elevation / height)): 10 is the whole sky, 0.3 a band low down.
The sky's and the aerial perspective's tint by the sun's elevation.
The sunlight's tint by the sun's elevation.
